snippet.title: Waterpark Simulator - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Waterpark Simulator 1.0 Launch is coming JULY 31ST, 2026!

💦Wishlist now and get ready: 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293260/Waterpark_Simulator
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017040
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/waterpark-simulator/9N055WD1VC99

Build your dream waterpark, ride your own custom slides, and cause chaos with your friends. This is a physics-based sandbox sim that does not take itself too seriously and has gotten a major upgrade from Early Access! 

🎮 ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

CayPlay Studios is an indie game studio co-founded by ‪@Caylus‬ and Travis Richardson. Focused on open-ended, creator-friendly games full of fun and chaos, Waterpark Simulator is Cayplay’s debut title with more to come.

Press Contact: press@cayplay.com
Presskit: https://impress.games/press-kit/cayplay-studios/waterpark-simulator

For more info and updates:
💬Discord:   /  http://discord.gg/waterparksimulator
🐦X/Twitter: https://x.com/WaterParkSim
🎵  Tiktok:   / @waterparksimulatorgame  

Video Produced & Edited by: 

Patrick Snipes 
X/Twitter: https://x.com/FTT_Pat
